description: This file contains unit tests for activation repartitioning, specifically testing frequency filtering logic and Zipf distribution sampling methods within the Orleans framework. It includes a test class with a method for assessing expected frequency top-K items, a custom key struct, a frequency collection class, and implementations related to Zipf distribution generation and rejection sampling.

classes.name: FrequencyFilterTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for frequency filtering and distribution sampling within Orleans activation repartitioning.

classes.name: TestKey
classes.description: A lightweight, immutable struct representing a key used in frequency collection testing, with static methods for generating sequential keys.

classes.name: UlongFrequentItemCollection
classes.description: A specialized collection for tracking frequencies of ulong keys, extending a generic FrequentItemCollection.

classes.name: FastZipf
classes.description: Provides static methods for efficient Zipf distribution sampling, generating large numbers of samples quickly.

classes.name: ZipfRejectionSampler
classes.description: Implements rejection sampling to generate Zipf-distributed random numbers, with parameters for cardinality and skew.

methods.name: GetExpectedTopK
methods.description: Unit test that generates and verifies the frequency of items sampled from a Zipf distribution, checking that the collection process correctly identifies frequent items.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Static method returning the next sequential TestKey.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an element from the frequency collection.

methods.name: Generate (static)
methods.description: Generates an array of Zipf-distributed samples with specified parameters.

methods.name: Sample
methods.description: Samples a Zipf-distributed number using rejection sampling.

methods.name: bInvCdf
methods.description: Computes the inverse CDF for the Zipf distribution used within the rejection sampling process.
